displayName: bol.com API - Prices, Offers, Sellers, NL and BE
description: bol.com API for bol.com competitor prices and marketplace data in the Netherlands and Belgium (EUR; storefronts nl-nl, be-nl, be-fr) - one product by product id, link or EAN with the buy box (price, seller, reference price and its type, delivery promise), offer counts and the cheapest new, fastest new, second-hand and refurbished offers; the 10 lowest-priced offers on one product with price, condition, shipping cost, delivery date and seller rating, plus counts for all its offers; keyword search, category, brand, seller and campaign listings with filters and sorts; seller profiles with rating out of 10, sub-ratings and EU trader data; today's deals and bol promotions such as Black Friday lists. 9 endpoints, 2 credits each (product by EAN 4). No price history, no review paging beyond the first 10.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
